title: Nourishing Indian Lentils Samosas
description: Salty, creamy lentil samosas made with tortilla wrappers, shio-koji cured for depth, diabetic-friendly and post-workout protein boost.
instructions: Rinse the lentils and cook them in boiling water until soft, about 15 minutes, then mash them with a fork.
In a pan, heat 1 tbsp coconut oil over medium heat and sauté onion, garlic, and ginger until fragrant and translucent.
Stir in cumin, coriander, and garam masala, cooking for 1 minute to bloom the spices.
Add the mashed lentils, shio-koji, and salt, then pour in coconut milk, stirring until the mixture thickens to a creamy consistency.
Turn off the heat and let the filling cool slightly.
Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet for 15 seconds on each side to make them pliable.
Place a spoonful of the lentil filling in the center of each tortilla, folding the sides over to form a pocket.
Roll up the tortillas tightly, sealing the edges with a little water if needed.
In a large skillet, heat the remaining coconut oil over medium-high heat.
Fry the samosa pockets until golden brown and crisp, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove the samosas from the oil and drain on paper towels.
Serve the samosas warm, optionally with a squeeze of lemon juice and a side of cilantro yogurt dip.
